additional_concerns: Neither candidate has executable meaning. Retrieval success and the unsupported LegalRuleML check establish no legal or executable correctness.

Retained accountability, supervisory conduct and satisfactory operational outcomes are distinct. The excerpts supply no complete fulfillment test, assessment period or incident/remediation standard; neither supervision alone nor every operational incident determines compliance.

The substantive candidate combines paragraph 10 with the proper-records and compatibility duty. That combination is an interpretive reading, not an expressly supplied cumulative test; effective supervision is not expressly prescribed here as a universal standalone condition.

Paragraph 14 separates confirmation from request-triggered demonstration. Footnote 5 leaves a rival reading concerning demonstration; absence of a request establishes neither substantive compliance nor SFC satisfaction.

Paragraph 15 concerns requested third-party audit or verification of three specified subjects; paragraph 16 concerns a requested satisfactory legal opinion supporting the application. Neither automatically supplies a retention or fulfillment test.

The full incorporated paragraphs 10–13, footnote 2 and applicable Appendix factors are not supplied. Section 6.8's register-location disclosure is distinct from register maintenance. Intermediary paragraph 13 must not be confused with the Product Provider circular's paragraph 13.
